news.title: Belgian FA still wants Balogun ban answers
news.lede: Goalscorer Balogun sent off for USA. Belgium's Football Association says it still wants answers about why Folarin Balogun was allowed to play against their team at the World Cup - and have asked for the issue to be on the agenda at the next Fifa Council. In one of the most controversial moments of the summer's World Cup, Balogun was cleared to play for co-hosts USA in the last-16 tie with Belgium after a one-game ban following a straight red card in his previous game was suspended for a year by Fifa. That was a highly unorthodox decision and received widespread criticism, especially after it emerged US President Donald Trump and White House officials had lobbied Fifa.

news.title: Can Kane buck history and win Ballon d'Or?
news.lede: Harry Kane helped England to third place in the World Cup. With the Ballon d'Or shortlist to be announced on Tuesday, Harry Kane heads the field as the bookmakers' favourite after a prolific season for club and country. History, however, suggests football's biggest individual prize is rarely decided on goals alone. Since the Ballon d'Or was first awarded in 1956, performances in the game's biggest competitions have consistently shaped the outcome.

news.title: Nigeria’s Flamingos Get Prominent Mention Ahead of FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: While all eyes are for now on the FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup in Poland, which began this past Saturday and the Falconets face Spain in their opening match on Monday, Nigeria has gained a prominent mention ahead of the cadet version in Qatar. Sports247 reports that, though the FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup is still two months away, Nigeria’s clash with the Republic in Group B has been named among the high-profile games to watch out for at the global championship, which is scheduled to be held from November 19th to December 13th. The Flamingos’ game with Korea is still far off, and attention for now is on the Falconets, but previews are already rolling ahead of the clash between Nigeria and the defending champions on Friday, October 23rd at the Women’s Football Complex.

news.title: GSC & TGV Are Hosting a Watch Party for the World Cup Final With Free-Flow Popcorn & Drinks
news.lede: There’s just something special about watching football with a crowd. Whether it’s celebrating a last-minute winner, gasping over a missed chance, or debating every refereeing decision, the experience always feels more exciting when you’re surrounded by fellow fans. With the 2026 FIFA World Cup final looming, it’s the perfect time to gather your football-loving friends and soak in the atmosphere together. Exclusively for the final match, two of Malaysia's well-known cinema chains, GSC and TGV, are set to host live watch parties.

news.title: Kylian Mbappe: Real Madrid forward says this could be good year to win Ballon d'Or
news.lede: Kylian Mbappe has scored four goals in four games for Real Madrid this season. Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappe says this could be a good year for him to win the Ballon d'Or for the first time. The 27-year-old scored 42 goals in 44 games for his club last season but they did not win any trophies. He won the World Cup Golden Boot with 10 goals, taking his career tally at World Cups to a record 22 - although France finished fourth.
